items.title: Scientists “truly astonished” by discovery that challenges Earth’s origin story
items.summary: A new study suggests Earth formed almost entirely from material in the inner Solar System, challenging the idea that water-rich material from beyond Jupiter played a major role. If correct, Earth’s water may have been present much closer to the young Sun than scientists previously thought.

items.title: Scientists recreated what mice saw from brain activity alone
items.summary: Scientists reconstructed videos from the brain activity of mice, producing 10-second clips based only on signals from neurons in the visual cortex. The breakthrough could help reveal how the brain reshapes what we see before it becomes our perception of reality.

items.title: Part-human part-mouse brain developed in science breakthrough
items.summary: Researchers at Stanford University genetically altered mice to be able to receive and function with human brain cells.
